For a suspected security vulnerability, stop and follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/peterhanily/threatcaddy/blob/main/SECURITY.md). Public issues are not a private reporting channel.

## Environment

App version or commit, hosted/standalone edition, browser and OS, language, extension version, and optional team-server version. Do not include private server addresses or credentials.

## Expected and actual behavior

Describe what should happen and what happened instead.

## Steps using synthetic data

Provide a small, repeatable example. State whether existing data or an unsaved draft was affected. Preserve a backup before retrying; do not clear browser storage as a troubleshooting step without one.

## Sanitized evidence

Include only reviewed error messages or screenshots. Remove investigation content, personal data, tokens, cookies, connection strings, browser profiles and private logs.
